description: This file provides an implementation of insecure transport credentials for gRPC, allowing connections without security. It includes functions and types for creating, managing, and using insecure credentials and bundles.

classes.name: insecureTC
classes.description: Implements insecure transport credentials with methods for handshake, info, clone, and override server name.

classes.name: info
classes.description: Contains authentication info for insecure connections, implements AuthInfo interface.

classes.name: insecureBundle
classes.description: Provides a thin wrapper around insecureTC to support the credentials.Bundle interface.

methods.name: NewCredentials
methods.description: Returns an insecure transport credentials object.

methods.name: ClientHandshake
methods.description: Performs client handshake, returns connection and security info.

methods.name: ServerHandshake
methods.description: Performs server handshake, returns connection and security info.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Returns protocol info indicating insecure connection.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of the insecure credentials.

methods.name: OverrideServerName
methods.description: Overrides server name, does nothing here.

methods.name: ValidateAuthority
methods.description: Allows any authority, always returns nil.

methods.name: NewWithMode
methods.description: Creates a new insecure bundle, mode parameter ignored.

methods.name: PerRPCCredentials
methods.description: Returns nil, as insecure bundle does not support per-RPC credentials.
